basic_details.job_title: Gauhati University Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Research Assistant, Field Investigator Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Folklore Studies, Gauhati University, needs one Research Assistant (Rs. 37,000/- monthly consolidated remuneration) and one Field Investigator (Rs. 20,000/- monthly consolidated remuneration) for an ICSSR-sponsored Major Research Project. Both appointments are purely temporary and run for three months, and the Research Assistant term may be extended as required. Candidates need a postgraduate degree in social science disciplines with a minimum of 55% marks; the Research Assistant also needs NET/M.Phil/Ph.D. Applications go by email to [email protected] on or before 28 Novembe

vacancy_details.Period of Appointment: Initially for three months, which may be extended as required

post_wise_breakdown.period_of_appointment: Initially for three months, which may be extended as required

how_to_apply: Applications are sent by email only, as the notice describes:
Prepare the application along with bio-data and relevant details.
Put the application, bio-data and certificates together in a single PDF file.
Mail the PDF to [email protected] on or before 28 November 2026.
The notice does not prescribe an application form or an email subject line.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 2 posts in total. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts.

rows.period_of_appointment: Initially for three months, which may be extended as required

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists one set of desirable qualifications without naming a post: Hands-on experience in conducting fieldwork, including handling interviews and applying participatory research methods Excellent academic writing skills in English Demonstrated research capability through academic publications in high-quality journals The notice does not mention an age limit for either post. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Postgraduate in social science disciplines (with minimum 55% marks) with NET/M.Phil/Ph.D.
Postgraduate in social science disciplines (with minimum 55% marks)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is a monthly consolidated remuneration: Rs. 37,000/- for the Research Assistant and Rs. 20,000/- for the Field Investigator. The notice does not mention HRA or any other allowance. Research Assistant: appointed initially for three months, which may be extended as required. Field Investigator: appointed for three months. The positions are purely temporary and may be terminated at any time before the stipulated period if the performance is not found to be satisfactory.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Gauhati University Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are sent by email only, as the notice describes: Prepare the application along with bio-data and relevant details. Include the relevant certificates. Put the application, bio-data and certificates together in a single PDF file. Mail the PDF to [email protected] on or before 28 November 2026. The notice does not prescribe an application form or an email subject line.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview at the Department of Folklore Studies, Gauhati University. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. The notice does not give the interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Gauhati University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Research Assistant and 1 Field Investigator in the ICSSR-sponsored project in the Department of Folklore Studies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be mailed to [email protected] on or before 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Postgraduate in social science disciplines (with minimum 55% marks) with NET/M.Phil/Ph.D.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: Postgraduate in social science disciplines (with minimum 55% marks).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated remuneration is Rs. 37,000/- for the Research Assistant and Rs. 20,000/- for the Field Investigator.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the application with bio-data and relevant details, including the relevant certificates, in a single PDF file to [email protected] on or before 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview at the Department of Folklore Studies, Gauhati University.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The positions are purely temporary: three months for the Field Investigator and initially three months for the Research Assistant, which may be extended as required. They may be terminated earlier if performance is not found to be satisfactory.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.
